codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Labor_Laborergebnis_Semiquantitativ
codeSystems.title: MII VS Laboratory Result Semiquantitative
codeSystems.description: Coding for semi-quantitative laboratory results

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Bestimmung_Ergebnis_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology General Determination Result [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Result ValueSet for general determination: the identified microorganism, or the negative result if no pathogen was identified.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Bestimmung_Methode_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology General Determination Method [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Method ValueSet for general determination: non-culture-based procedures for identifying a pathogen without a predefined target, such as microscopy or MALDI-TOF.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Bestimmung_Tests_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology General Determination Tests [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for general determination: LOINC codes for the untargeted identification of a microorganism. 41852-5 is preferred; the remaining codes are equally permitted where the laboratory names the pathogen group or the sequencing target in the code.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Kultur_Methode_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology General Culture Method [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Method ValueSet for general culture: culture procedures without restriction to a predefined pathogen, including aerobic and anaerobic incubation.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Kultur_Tests_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology General Culture Tests [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for general culture: LOINC codes for untargeted culture investigation. 11475-1 is preferred because the code names the procedure itself; 41852-5 is equally permitted.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Mikroskopie_Tests_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology General Microscopy Tests [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for general microscopy: nominal LOINC codes for microscopic observation whose result is the morphology seen. 105059-0 is preferred because it is method-neutral; the codes with a stain in the name (Gram, acid-fast, rhodamine-auramine) are equally permitted and leave Observation.method free in return.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Antigen_Antikoerper_Methode_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Antigen Antibody Method [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Method ValueSet for quantitative antigen and antibody tests and for avidity determination: immunological detection procedures.
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-anti: MII PR Microbiology Antigen Antibody Quantitative

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Antigen_Antikoerper_Quantitativ_Einheiten_UCUM
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Antigen Antibody Quantitative Units [UCUM]
codeSystems.description: Unit ValueSet for quantitative antigen and antibody tests (UCUM). Bound to Observation.valueQuantity.code.
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-anti: MII PR Microbiology Antigen Antibody Quantitative

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Antigen_Antikoerper_Quantitative_Tests_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Antigen Antibody Quantitative Tests [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for quantitative antigen and antibody tests: LOINC codes for measuring pathogen-specific antigens or antibodies.
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-anti: MII PR Microbiology Antigen Antibody Quantitative

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Aviditaet_Ergebnis
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Avidity Result
codeSystems.description: Assessment ValueSet for avidity: categorical classification of the avidity index as low, borderline or high. Low avidity indicates a recent infection.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Aviditaet_Tests_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Avidity Tests [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for avidity determination: LOINC codes for avidity tests including the target antigen.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Bartlett_Score_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Bartlett Score [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Result ValueSet for the Bartlett score: score categories from +3 to -1 that rate the ratio of inflammatory to epithelial cells and thus the suitability of a sputum specimen for culture.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Befundtyp_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Report Type [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Specialised coding of microbiological reports

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_CT_Wert_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Ct Value [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for the Ct value: LOINC codes with the property cycle threshold in nucleic acid detection.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Data_Absent_Reason
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Data Absent Reason
codeSystems.description: Reasons for a missing investigation result. Supplements the FHIR base codes with the indeterminable result that was previously coded via value[x].
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-anti: MII PR Microbiology Antigen Antibody Quantitative
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-mole: MII PR Microbiology Molecular Pathogen Load
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-resi: MII PR Microbiology Resistance Mechanisms Determinants
MII PR Microbiology Resistance Category Status

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Detected_Not_Detected_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Detected Not Detected [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Result ValueSet for targeted qualitative detections: detected or not detected. An indeterminable result is represented not here but via Observation.dataAbsentReason.
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-resi: MII PR Microbiology Resistance Mechanisms Determinants
codeSystems.ValueSet-mii-vs-mikrobio-spezifische-bes: MII VS Microbiology Specific Determination Result [SNOMED]

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Empfindlichkeit_Einheiten_UCUM
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Susceptibility Units [UCUM]
codeSystems.description: Unit ValueSet for phenotypic susceptibility testing (UCUM): minimum inhibitory concentration in mg/L or inhibition zone diameter in mm.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Empfaenglichkeit_Genotyp_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Susceptibility Genotype [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for predicted susceptibility: LOINC codes for the predicted efficacy of an antimicrobial substance derived from the genotype.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Empfindlichkeit_Methode_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Susceptibility Method [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Method ValueSet for phenotypic susceptibility testing: the procedures used to measure a minimum inhibitory concentration or an inhibition zone diameter.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Empfindlichkeit_Phenotyp_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Susceptibility Phenotype [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for phenotypic susceptibility testing: LOINC codes of the antimicrobial substance tested.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Faerbung_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Staining [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Staining procedures of the microscopic examination, e.g. Gram stain or Kinyoun stain.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Keimzahl_Einheiten_UCUM
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Colony Count Units [UCUM]
codeSystems.description: Unit ValueSet for colony counting (UCUM): colony-forming units per volume, per mass or as a count per specimen.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Keimzahl_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Colony Count [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for colony counting: LOINC codes for the quantitative determination of viable microorganisms.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Kultur_Ergebnis_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Culture Result [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Result ValueSet for general and specific culture: growth, no growth or an equivocal result. How much has grown is not stated by this ValueSet but by the colony count. An indeterminable result is represented not via value[x] but via Observation.dataAbsentReason.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Mikroskopie_Gesichtsfeld_Einheiten_UCUM
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Microscopy Field of View Units [UCUM]
codeSystems.description: Units for the count per field of view in the quantity component of microscopy.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Mikroskopie_Semiquantitativ_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Microscopy Semiquantitative [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Quantity ValueSet for microscopy: the semiquantitative grade in which a microscopic finding was seen.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Molekulare_Diagnostik_Einheiten_UCUM
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Molecular Diagnostics Units [UCUM]
codeSystems.description: Unit ValueSet for molecular pathogen load (UCUM): concentration units such as copies per millilitre.
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-mole: MII PR Microbiology Molecular Pathogen Load

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Molekulare_Pathogenlast_Methode_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Molecular Pathogen Load Method [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Method ValueSet for molecular pathogen load: amplification procedures for quantifying pathogen nucleic acid.
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-mole: MII PR Microbiology Molecular Pathogen Load

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Molekulare_Pathogenlast_Tests_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Molecular Pathogen Load Tests [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for molecular pathogen load: quantitative LOINC codes for the nucleic acid concentration of a pathogen.
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-mole: MII PR Microbiology Molecular Pathogen Load

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Morphologie_Ergebnis_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Morphology Result [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Result ValueSet for microscopy: the morphological group observed microscopically, such as Gram-positive cocci in clusters or Gram-negative rods. A species identification does not belong here, even if it was made microscopically.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Morphologie_Methode_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Morphology Method [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Method ValueSet for microscopy: the microscopic procedures used. The stain is stated not here but in the extension MII_EX_Mikrobio_Faerbung.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_MRGN_Klasse_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology MRGN Class [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Result ValueSet for the MRGN classification: 2MRGN, 3MRGN and 4MRGN according to the RKI categorisation. The negative classification is in the module's own CodeSystem, because the LOINC answer list does not carry it.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Organismen_SNOMEDCT
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Organisms [SNOMED CT]
codeSystems.description: Organism ValueSet: the SNOMED CT hierarchies from which an identified pathogen may come. Not bound directly, but included in the result ValueSets of the determination profiles.
codeSystems.ValueSet-mii-vs-mikrobio-allgemeine-best: MII VS Microbiology General Determination Result [SNOMED]

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Resistenzkategorie_Status
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Resistance Category Status
codeSystems.description: Investigation codes for assessing a detected pathogen with regard to a defined resistance category.
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-resi: MII PR Microbiology Resistance Category Status

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Resistenzkategorie_Status_Ergebnis
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Resistance Category Status Result
codeSystems.description: Result of assessing a detected pathogen with regard to the resistance category given in Observation.code.
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-resi: MII PR Microbiology Resistance Category Status

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Resistenzmechanismen_Determinanten_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Resistance Mechanisms Determinants [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for resistance mechanisms and determinants: LOINC codes for the detection of resistance genes, resistance proteins and functional resistance tests.
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-resi: MII PR Microbiology Resistance Mechanisms Determinants

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Resistenzmechanismen_Methode_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Resistance Mechanisms Method [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Methods for detecting resistance mechanisms and determinants: molecular, immunological and functional procedures.
codeSystems.StructureDefinition-mii-pr-mikrobio-resi: MII PR Microbiology Resistance Mechanisms Determinants

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Spezifische_Bestimmung_Ergebnis_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Specific Determination Result [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Result ValueSet for specific determination: detection or exclusion of the target already named in the investigation code, including the grey-zone findings weakly positive and equivocal. An indeterminable result is represented not via value[x] but via Observation.dataAbsentReason.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Spezifische_Bestimmung_Methode_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Specific Determination Method [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Method ValueSet for specific determination: non-culture-based procedures for targeted pathogen detection, such as amplification, immunoassay or agglutination.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Spezifische_Bestimmung_Tests_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Specific Determination Tests [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for specific determination.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Spezifische_Mikroskopie_Tests_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Specific Microscopy Tests [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for specific microscopy: ordinal LOINC codes in which the object sought and the staining technique are named in the code; the result is the detection, the quantity is in the quantity component.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Susceptibility
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Susceptibility
codeSystems.description: Assessment ValueSet for phenotypic susceptibility testing: the categories susceptible, intermediate, susceptible, increased exposure, resistant and non-susceptible.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Susceptibility_NORM
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Susceptibility Norm
codeSystems.description: Norm ValueSet for susceptibility testing: the interpretive standard (e.g. EUCAST, CLSI) on whose breakpoints a category is based. Bound to the extension MII_EX_Mikrobio_Empfindlichkeit_Norm.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Titer_Methode_SNOMED
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Titre Method [SNOMED]
codeSystems.description: Method ValueSet for titre determination: serial dilution procedures.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Titer_Tests_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Titre Tests [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for titre determination: LOINC codes for semiquantitative measurements from dilution series.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Virulenz_LOINC
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Virulence [LOINC]
codeSystems.description: Test ValueSet for virulence factors: LOINC codes for the detection or exclusion of virulence determinants.

codeSystems.name: MII_VS_Mikrobio_Voraussichtliche_Empfindlichkeit
codeSystems.title: MII VS Microbiology Predicted Susceptibility
codeSystems.description: Result ValueSet for predicted susceptibility: the predicted category susceptible, intermediate or resistant derived from genotypic detections.
